features.description: Implement AI embedding ops and deterministic stubs
acceptance_criteria: effects.Call denies absent AI capability and zero budget before network access.
With AI and no chat handler, a fake Ollama server receives the call; an unrelated chat provider does not reroute it.
Stub vectors are repeatable, distinct across representative inputs, unit magnitude, and perform no network requests.
Text/media successes and failures emit bounded trace arguments without raw media bytes.

features.description: Expose Result builtins and standard wrappers
acceptance_criteria: All four builtin registrations and type signatures require AI; wrappers type-check.

features.notes: Four AI signatures and std wrappers verified with runtime/evaluator calls. Result catches only marked embedding failures; capability, source-budget and operator-budget denial remain errors. One charge per evaluator call. AILANG prompt v0.16.7 loaded.
